# Auto-generated by Scripts/regenerate_generated_items.py — do not hand edit.
# Scope-target helpers for the generated-item shop slots and adventure loot.

# Picks a uniform random item from a generated-item pool and tries to stock it.
# Mirrors omni_add_item_to_shop_stock, but takes the item as a saved scope so a
# single effect serves all 8,000 items.
omni_pick_gen_stock_item = {
	random_in_global_list = {
		variable = $POOL$
		save_scope_as = omni_gen_item_pick
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:omni_gen_item_pick }
		omni_add_scoped_item_to_shop_stock = yes
	}
}

omni_add_scoped_item_to_shop_stock = {
	scope:omni_shop_owner = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = omni_item_shop_stock target = scope:omni_gen_item_pick } }
				OR = {
					AND = { var:omni_shop_max_items = 4 var:omni_shop_item_count < 4 }
					AND = { var:omni_shop_max_items = 6 var:omni_shop_item_count < 6 }
					AND = { var:omni_shop_max_items = 8 var:omni_shop_item_count < 8 }
					AND = { var:omni_shop_max_items = 10 var:omni_shop_item_count < 10 }
				}
			}
			add_to_variable_list = { name = omni_item_shop_stock target = scope:omni_gen_item_pick }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = omni_item_shop_stock_gen target = scope:omni_gen_item_pick }
			change_variable = { name = omni_shop_item_count add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Buys the generated item held in character variable omni_shop_slot_$SLOT$.
# Price by rarity matches the old per-item options (60/120/200).
omni_buy_generated_slot_item = {
	if = { limit = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = item_common_rarity target = var:omni_shop_slot_$SLOT$ } } add_gold = -60 }
	else_if = { limit = { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = item_uncommon_rarity target = var:omni_shop_slot_$SLOT$ } } add_gold = -120 }
	else = { add_gold = -200 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = item_list target = var:omni_shop_slot_$SLOT$ } } }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = item_list target = var:omni_shop_slot_$SLOT$ }
	}
	remove_list_variable = { name = omni_item_shop_stock target = var:omni_shop_slot_$SLOT$ }
	remove_list_variable = { name = omni_item_shop_stock_gen target = var:omni_shop_slot_$SLOT$ }
	# Apply the bought item's modifier to the buyer (hidden so the tooltip isn't
	# duplicated; the option's show_as_tooltip renders it instead).
	hidden_effect = { omni_gen_slot_apply_modifier = { SLOT = $SLOT$ } }
	remove_variable = omni_shop_slot_$SLOT$
}

# Adventure loot: pick from a pool and hand straight to ROOT (the adventurer).
omni_adventure_pick_gen_item = {
	random_in_global_list = {
		variable = $POOL$
		save_scope_as = omni_gen_item_pick
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:omni_gen_item_pick }
		ROOT = { omni_give_scoped_gen_item = yes }
	}
}

omni_give_scoped_gen_item = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = item_list target = scope:omni_gen_item_pick } } }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = item_list target = scope:omni_gen_item_pick }
	}
}
